header: TRANSIENT OCCUPANCY DECLARATION — SHORT TERM RENTAL

blocks.text: This Transient Occupancy Declaration is attached to and made part of the Short Term Rental Agreement dated {{agreement_date}} between {{host_name}} ("Owner") and {{guest_name}} ("Guest").

The Owner declares that the property located at {{property_address}} (the "Property") is offered for short-term transient occupancy only. The Guest's occupancy of the Property under this Agreement creates a TEMPORARY LICENSE TO OCCUPY, and NOT a residential tenancy, lease, or landlord-tenant relationship of any kind.
The Guest acknowledges and agrees that:

items: This Agreement creates a temporary license to occupy the Property for the period specified in the Agreement. It does NOT create a tenancy, lease, or landlord-tenant relationship.

The Guest has no right to occupy the Property beyond the period stated in the Agreement. Upon expiration of the check-out date and time, Guest's license to occupy terminates and Guest must vacate the Property.
The Guest is classified as a TRANSIENT OCCUPANT, not a resident or tenant. The Guest does not establish the Property as their primary residence.
The Guest has no right to renew this Agreement, to extend the stay beyond the stated checkout date, or to request a new Agreement. Any extension must be a new, separate booking.

If the Guest remains in the Property after the checkout date and time without a new booking, the Guest becomes a holdover occupant / trespasser. The Owner may pursue all available legal remedies, including eviction, trespass actions, and recovery of damages.

The Guest is not entitled to any rights or protections under state or local landlord-tenant laws, including but not limited to: notice to quit, eviction procedures, habitability warranties, security deposit interest, rent control, or any other tenant protection.
The Guest's occupancy is subject to all the terms and conditions of the Short Term Rental Agreement and all attached addenda.
The Guest agrees that any dispute arising from this Agreement shall be governed by the laws applicable to transient occupancy / vacation rentals, not residential tenancies.
If any court or tribunal finds that this Agreement created a tenancy despite the terms herein, the Guest immediately surrenders any claim to continued occupancy and must vacate within 24 hours.

blocks.text: The Guest's total stay under this Agreement and any extensions or consecutive bookings MUST NOT exceed {{max_stay_days}} consecutive days. If the Guest's total stay reaches {{max_stay_days}} days, the Guest must vacate the Property. A new stay may be booked after a gap of at least {{minimum_gap_days}} days, subject to Owner's approval and availability.

Stays that exceed the {{max_stay_days}}-day threshold may be reclassified as a residential tenancy under applicable state law (e.g., California Civil Code §1940(b), SB 644). The Owner is not obligated to accept any booking that would cause the threshold to be exceeded.

By signing below, Guest acknowledges having read, understood, and agreed to this Transient Occupancy Declaration. Guest confirms that the Property will not be used as Guest's primary residence during the stay.
